cues.en: In five videos I share with you Michael Faraday's great nineteenth century lecture series The Chemical History of a Candle.
cues.zh: 我将通过五个视频，带大家重温 Michael Faraday 19世纪的经典系列讲座 The Chemical History of a Candle。

cues.en: Faraday said of a candle: There is no more open door by which you can enter into the study of science than by considering the physical phenomena of a candle.
cues.zh: Faraday 曾这样评价蜡烛：“要想踏入科学研究的大门，最好的切入点莫过于探究蜡烛的物理现象。”

cues.en: Even now, a hundred and fifty years after Faraday delivered his lectures, one would be hard pressed to find an object of study that would equal a candle.
cues.zh: 即使在 Faraday 演讲150年后的今天，也很难找到能与蜡烛相媲美的研究对象。

cues.en: Through a careful examination of a burning candle, Faraday reveals the concepts of mass, density, heat conduction, capillary action, and convection currents.
cues.zh: 通过对燃烧蜡烛的细致观察，Faraday 揭示了质量、密度、热传导、毛细现象以及对流的概念。

cues.en: He demonstrates the difference between chemical and physical processes.
cues.zh: 他阐明了化学过程与物理过程的区别。

cues.en: He reveals the properties of hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, and carbon dioxide.
cues.zh: 他揭示了氢气、氧气、氮气和二氧化碳的性质。

cues.en: And in a stunning final lecture he uses a candle to explain human respiration.
cues.zh: 在精彩绝伦的最后一讲中，他甚至用蜡烛解释了人类的呼吸作用。

cues.en: In creating these videos we used Faraday's original language because his poetic turns of phrase charmed us. We changed his words only when necessary.
cues.zh: 在制作这些视频时，我们尽量保留了 Faraday 的原话，因为他富有诗意的遣词造句深深吸引了我们，只在必要时才作调整。

cues.en: We updated terminology,
cues.zh: 我们更新了部分术语，

cues.en: especially chemical terms, and we replaced some demonstrations with modern or safer ones.
cues.zh: 特别是化学术语，并用更现代或更安全的实验替换了其中的一部分展示。

cues.en: Even with these changes, the lectures can be a challenge for the modern viewer and so to help today's viewers appreciate the lectures my co creators and I have done three things.
cues.zh: 即便做了这些调整，这些讲座对现代观众来说可能依然有些门槛；因此，为了帮助大家更好地领略其中的精髓，我和合作者们做了三件事。

cues.en: First, we created an alternate version of each lecture that has a commentary track.
cues.zh: 首先，我们为每一讲都制作了附带解说音轨的特别版本。

cues.en: In the commentary track my co creator Don DeCoste and I guide viewers through the lectures highlighting the concepts underlying Faraday's demonstrations.
cues.zh: 在解说音轨中，我和共同创作者 Don DeCoste 会带大家梳理这些讲座，重点解析 Faraday 演示背后的核心概念。

cues.en: And second, we added captions to all the videos including the commentary versions. And third,
cues.zh: 第二，我们为所有视频都添加了字幕，包括解说版。第三，

cues.en: we wrote a companion book for this video series that is available as a PDF for free.
cues.zh: 我们为这个视频系列编写了一本配套书，可以免费下载 PDF。

cues.en: The book contains the complete transcript of each lecture as delivered in the video series.
cues.zh: 书中收录了该视频系列中每场讲座的完整逐字稿。

cues.en: To help you grasp Faraday's key points it has an essential background section that explains in modern terms how a canvas works.
cues.zh: 为了帮大家抓住 Faraday 的核心要点，书中设有基础背景章节，用现代术语解释了蜡烛的工作原理。

cues.en: And each lecture is preceded by a short guide written in contemporary language.
cues.zh: 每场讲座前都附有一份用现代通俗语言编写的导读。

cues.en: These guides mirror the lectures chronologically so you can follow while watching the lectures.
cues.zh: 这些导读与讲座的时间顺序保持一致，方便大家边看视频边参考。

cues.en: In addition, the book has a detailed teaching guide.
cues.zh: 此外，书中还包含一份详尽的教学指南。

cues.en: Faraday aimed his lectures toward those new to scienceespecially
cues.zh: Faraday 的讲座面向的是刚接触科学的人，尤其是

cues.en: young people.
cues.zh: 年轻人。

cues.en: His lectures remain today an excellent introduction to the scientific method and serve well as an entry point to the chemical sciences.
cues.zh: 直到今天，他的讲座依然是对科学方法的绝佳介绍，非常适合作为化学科学的入门读物。

cues.en: The teaching guide contains a section called The Big Ideas of Chemistry
cues.zh: 教学指南中包含一个名为 The Big Ideas of Chemistry 的章节，

cues.en: which uses simple analogies to introduce younger students to the particulate nature of matter.
cues.zh: 它用通俗的比喻向初学者介绍物质的微粒性。

cues.en: Following this, the guide contains six activities and one set of demonstrations
cues.zh: 随后，指南还提供了六项活动和一组演示实验，

cues.en: that teachers can use to help students investigate for themselves the chemical history of a candle.
cues.zh: 供教师用来引导学生亲自探究蜡烛的化学史。

cues.en: Each activity has a student worksheet followed by a teacher's guide. Teachers can use these guides and student worksheets for free.
cues.zh: 每项活动都有一份学生活动单，后面附有教师指南。教师可以免费使用这些指南和学生活动单。

cues.en: We give you the complete book free as a PDF.
cues.zh: 我们免费提供整本书的 PDF 版。

cues.en: You can download the book at engineerguide.com/faraday
cues.zh: 你可以在 engineerguide.com/faraday 下载这本书。

cues.en: or you can buy it as an e book in paperback or hardcover.
cues.zh: 也可以购买电子书、平装本或精装本。

cues.en: So I hope you enjoy the lectures. For me and my co creators, Don DeCoste and Alex Black, they were a labor of love. I'm Bill Hammack, the engineer guy.
cues.zh: 希望你们喜欢这些讲座。对我和共同创作者 Don DeCoste、Alex Black 来说，这些讲座是倾注心血之作。我是 Bill Hammack，the engineer guy。
